note: High/Critical findings are blocking unless an entry below is unexpired and owned. Remove an exemption as soon as the dependency is upgraded. Moderate/Low findings are reported but do not block.

exemptions.reason: Transitive optional dependency of the Prisma CLI (@prisma/client > prisma > @prisma/config > effect). Haft imports neither effect nor @prisma/config at runtime. The fix is bundled with a Prisma major upgrade; direct dependency upgrades are intentionally out of scope for P2-04.
Transitive optional dependency of the Prisma CLI toolchain, not imported by Haft runtime code. Fix requires the same Prisma toolchain upgrade as advisory 1115356.

The patched release is Zod 4 (>=4.6.6) while contracts intentionally pin Zod 3 (^3.25.76). A major migration would change every shared contract and is out of scope for P2-04. Request bodies are size-limited and the API is loopback-only until P2-03/P2-05; residual risk is tracked.
exemptions.tracking: P2-00 contracts baseline / dedicated Zod 4 migration

exemptions.reason: Transitive dependency of @nestjs/platform-express. Haft exposes JSON REST endpoints only and has no multipart upload route, so the affected fileFilter path is not reachable. Fix requires a coordinated NestJS platform upgrade.
